description: Lists the signed-in partner's own bank-transfer settlements of the credit line: `settlements[]` (each with `reference`, `status`, `amount`, `currency`, `createdAt`, `expiresAt`, and `receivedAmount`/`receivedAt` once the transfer has arrived), `payable[]` (transfers still awaiting funds), the `bank` details to pay into, and a `notice` that must be shown to the user as given (overpayments are held as credit, not refunded). This is the list of transfers, not per-booking payment state: that is on each row of `get_credit_line_statement`. Read-only. Needs a signed-in partner credit-line account session; guest sessions have no credit line.
name: list_settlements
title: List Bank Transfers
